findings.reason: MI001 remains OPEN, status NOT_FOUND, needed_at adequacy, originating in main:/missing_information/items/0. This item supplies fitted PD targets and R2, without per-regimen CFU observations or traceable regimen-exposure-response records. It does not resolve DR018 or establish that independent index comparison is possible. This page-level assessment cannot establish absence elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: At adequacy review, determine whether authorized response evidence supports the intended comparisons. Obtain source-backed regimen-level CFU responses and exposure mappings where authorized, or explicitly retain the limitation without reconstructing observations. Preserve independent PK and exposure-summary tasks.

findings.reason: A14 reports n = 4 thighs per dose and explicitly leaves mice per group unstated. The table contains fitted parameters by bacterial strain and an Avg row, without animal identifiers, parameter uncertainty or a stated averaging procedure. Thigh counts cannot establish independent mouse counts. NA and ND have distinct definitions in A15.
findings.needed_material: Retain reported-parameter status, strain membership, Avg, NA and ND. Obtain experimental-unit relationships and uncertainty definitions if needed for downstream use; do not assign animal identities or infer mouse counts.

findings.reason: Available context includes neutropenia, thigh infection, inoculum volume and concentration, treatment starting 2 h postinfection, dosing every 2, 4 or 6 h over 24 h, and harvest 2 h after the last treatment. Baseline controls are described, but their measured burdens and untreated growth-control observations are not supplied. Per-injection doses, mice per group, regimen-specific responses, exposure links and compatible PK evidence are not supplied. Different intervals are documented, but index separation is not established by this summary.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked regimen-dose schedules, response observations, baseline and untreated growth-control values, exact response reference and timing, and compatible PK-to-PD mappings. Preserve harvest timing relative to the last treatment without assuming a common elapsed endpoint.

findings.reason: Rows 17-22 provide meropenem MICs in mg/liter linked to the six named A. baumannii strains. Measurement method, medium, testing standard, replicate count and summary-value definition are NOT_FOUND on this page. The Avg-row MIC is NA, meaning not applicable.
findings.needed_material: Authorized strain-specific MIC measurement context and confirmation of its relationship to the corresponding PD experiment. Keep the reported MIC values and units unchanged.

findings.reason: The headers explicitly report percentage targets for a 24-h fT>MIC index and distinguish stasis, 1 log CFU killing and 2 log CFU killing. Exposure-window time origin, source-linked free-concentration profiles, binding inputs and regimen-level exposure-response pairs are NOT_FOUND. Reported target percentages do not supply those inputs.
findings.needed_material: Specify the intended exposure-window origin and threshold definition, and obtain source-linked PK or free-exposure inputs, binding assessment and matched regimen-response records. Retain the source's percentage convention without calculating new indices.

findings.reason: This page reports fT>MIC targets and MICs. It does not supply free AUC values, concentration-time observations, AUC units or windows, or regimen-linked AUC-response records. No MC010 match is asserted.
findings.needed_material: Authorized source-linked free AUC or compatible PK inputs, AUC definition and window, binding dependency and matched regimen-response mapping for the planned common comparison.

findings.reason: This page does not supply free Cmax values, concentration observations, peak definitions, peak windows or dose numbers, or regimen-linked peak-response records. No MC011 match is asserted.
findings.needed_material: Authorized source-linked free Cmax or compatible PK inputs, sampled/reported/predicted peak definition, evaluation window and dose number, binding dependency and matched response mapping.

findings.reason: MI011 remains OPEN, status DEFERRED, needed_at index, originating in main:/missing_information/items/10. The source's inhibitory Emax model and R2 values do not supply the registered project selection rule required by DR019. No winning index or regression family is established.
findings.needed_material: Register the selection rule before fitting, preserving equal eligibility of all three indices, both regression families, organism/site strata, matched records and common MIC, free-exposure, dosing, window and likelihood definitions. Specify R², AIC/BIC, stability, identifiability, extra Hill-parameter accounting and an inconclusive-result option.

findings.reason: The fitted targets and R2 values are published summaries attributed to S04, DOI 10.1128/aac.02388-19, Table 3. They supply target provenance but cannot determine primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings under R013. Their presence does not establish independent model or target qualification.
findings.needed_material: Carry the published-summary provenance and use restriction into downstream review; document independent provenance for primary-analysis initialization, constraints, priors and ranking decisions.

findings.reason: Source-reported %24-h fT>MIC targets are available separately for stasis, 1 log CFU killing and 2 log CFU killing in this A. baumannii neutropenic thigh context. AB1137 has ND for 2 log CFU killing. Target uncertainty, downstream qualification and freeze records are NOT_FOUND. Project target estimation and qualification remain deferred T04 outputs for T06; missing response observations remain a separate MI001 limitation.
findings.needed_material: Before PTA, obtain the documented T04 target output or inconclusive determination, with effect-specific endpoint reference, organism/strain/site context, treatment and exposure windows, free-exposure definition, units, uncertainty, applicability assessment and target freeze. Do not substitute these published targets for the required independent analysis.
